text:
The median asking rent in Dortmund sits at 9.7 €/m², with a year‑on‑year rise of 2.4 % and a five‑year gain of 23.2 %. The inter‑quartile spread runs from 8.4 €/m² to 11.19 €/m², placing the city 29th of the 37 most expensive markets.

Asking rents sit about 50 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 6.45 €/m², while a typical 60 m² unit costs 582 € per month and the rent‑burden for two residents is 14.4 %. Listings spend an average of 33 days on market, with 22 % let within a week, and vacancy stands at 2.1 %, indicating a balanced but tight market.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 10.31 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 10.02 €/m² and 10.52 €/m² – a 6.2 % increase.
